name: Captain's Chair Leg Raise
steps: Position your forearms on the dip station pads, grip the handles, and press your back firmly against the backrest.
Let your legs hang straight beneath your hips with feet together and core braced.
Brace your abdomen and lift your legs together toward hip height, keeping your knees softly extended.
Lower your legs slowly under control until they hang quietly without swinging.
tips: Press into the pads to keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Raise your legs only as far as you can keep your trunk steady and control the descent.
